application_boundaries: The user rejects a mandatory whole-film template; this does not prohibit suitable existing techniques or authorized faithful replication.
Realistic photographic material fits this GEO revision; do not turn its renovation room, desk, phone or source-window sequence into every future video's default.

Fresh creation must respect an already approved edit's requested modification scope and preserve source narration permissions.
Asset authenticity, generated-illustration disclosure, spending authorization and external publication boundaries remain unchanged.
